content:
Apple TV is set to launch a brand-new original comedy series, "Brothers," starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson, next month. Here is the trailer.

"Brothers" premieres on September 23. The show is created by Lee Eisenberg, known for his work on "The Office."

Apple TV is currently airing the fourth season of "Ted Lasso," but another highly anticipated comedy is about to make its debut.

"Brothers," starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson, is a brand-new original series from Apple TV, with the two playing fictionalised versions of themselves.

"Brothers" will premiere on September 23 (Wednesday), with the first two episodes dropping at once, followed by new episodes released weekly until November 4.

The series is the brainchild of Lee Eisenberg, who served as a writer and producer on seasons two through six of the acclaimed show "The Office," and was a key member of the creative team.

Below is the synopsis Apple has provided for "Brothers," followed by the trailer:

Besides "Brothers," other new content on Apple TV in September includes a new season of "Slow Horses," original crime thriller "Last Seen," and the film "Mayday," starring Ryan Reynolds.

What did you think of the "Brothers" trailer? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, and a discounted bundle is also available through Apple One.
